name: mri-vscode
description: Surfaces MRI's analysis inline while editing: risk scores, blast radius, dead code, coverage, and fail-closed guard checks.

commands.title: MRI: Refresh analysis for this workspace
MRI: Show blast radius for this function

mri.entryPoint.markdownDescription: Path to MRI's CLI entry point (`dist/cli/index.js`). Leave empty to auto-detect: the workspace itself, a sibling `../mri` checkout, then `mri` on PATH.

mri.codeLensEnabled.description: Show risk score and blast-radius CodeLenses above functions/classes.

mri.autoRefreshOnSave.description: Re-run MRI analysis when a file is saved (debounced), instead of on every keystroke.

mri.saveDebounceMs.description: How long to wait after a save before re-running analysis (coalesces rapid saves).

mri.churnWindowDays.description: Git churn window (days) used for risk scoring.

mri.guardResourcesPath.markdownDescription: Optional path to a guard resource-grant JSON config passed as `--resources`. See MRI's resource-grant schema.
